First writing example wrongly attributes prior fear and embarrassment to the final discovery.

findings.evidence: The model says 'Finding her missing sketchbook after a week of worry gave Noor an emotional ride' and then lists earlier fear and embarrassment followed by relief. The final act of finding cannot have caused the earlier phases; the search across the week is the experience that carried her through them.
findings.repair: Make the week-long search the subject of the emotional ride and keep the fear → embarrassment → relief sequence. Align Traditional Chinese and recalculate any affected answer-derived glossary spans.

coverageLimit: All eleven received automated source, selected-collision, target-key, speaking-span, glossary and guide-copy checks; I inspected source-sense, reply validity, scene, EN/ZH and both writing models with emphasis on material errors. This is risk-based AI content review, not listening or release certification.
